published.citation: TESS Input Catalog 8.2 (VizieR IV/39/tic82), TIC 283410775: Teff: 3240 K; the source gives no uncertainty, so the range is the value itself, https://vizier.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/VizieR?-source=IV/39/tic82

temperature.note: The Washington Double Star catalogue (Mason et al. 2001, AJ 122, 3466; VizieR B/wds/wds) lists WDS 22012+2818 RAO 691: 0.3 arcsec apart, magnitudes 10 and 11.9: the companion gives 14.8% of the light, which a measured spectrum would blend with the star's. The color is the Planck spectrum at the star's temperature, so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
